policy.profile.strict.blurb: Reads the folders you give it, changes nothing, and talks only to its AI provider.
policy.profile.strict.b1: Every folder is read-only. The agent can look, never change.
policy.profile.strict.b2: The network is limited to hosts the key broker holds a key for, usually the AI provider.
policy.profile.strict.b3: Good for reviewers, Q&A bots and anything people outside your team can talk to.
policy.profile.workspace.blurb: Reads and changes the folders you give it, and can download packages from npm, PyPI and GitHub.
policy.profile.workspace.b1: Folders mounted read-write can be changed. Git folders get their own branch per session, so nothing lands on main without you.
policy.profile.workspace.b2: Package registries are reachable so installs and builds work.
policy.profile.workspace.b3: Good for agents that write code for you.
policy.profile.custom.blurb: Exactly the rules you set. beamhop adds nothing on top.
policy.profile.custom.b1: Folders, hosts and keys are only what you list.
policy.profile.custom.b2: Use learning mode to discover what the agent really needs, then allow it one rule at a time.
policy.profile.custom.b3: Good when strict is too tight and workspace too wide.
